# checkmk_tag_group (Resource)

Manages a CheckMK host tag group configuration. Tag groups do not require activation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "blackmesaltd/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

resource "checkmk_tag_group" "environment" {
  id    = "environment"
  title = "Environment"
  topic = "Custom Tags"
  help  = "Classify hosts by their environment"

  tags = [
    {
      id       = "prod"
      title    = "Production"
      aux_tags = []
    },
    {
      id       = "dev"
      title    = "Development"
      aux_tags = []
    },
    {
      id       = "test"
      title    = "Testing"
      aux_tags = []
    },
  ]
}
```

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "blackmesaltd/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Example with auxiliary tags
resource "checkmk_tag_group" "location" {
  id    = "location"
  title = "Data Center Location"
  topic = "Infrastructure"

  tags = [
    {
      id       = "dc1"
      title    = "Data Center 1 (US-East)"
      aux_tags = ["us", "east"]
    },
    {
      id       = "dc2"
      title    = "Data Center 2 (US-West)"
      aux_tags = ["us", "west"]
    },
    {
      id       = "dc3"
      title    = "Data Center 3 (EU-Central)"
      aux_tags = ["eu", "central"]
    },
  ]
}
```

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "blackmesaltd/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Example with resource-level strict ETag locking enabled
resource "checkmk_tag_group" "application" {
  id    = "application"
  title = "Application Type"

  # Enable strict resource locking for this specific resource
  # This will fetch and validate ETags to detect drift
  strict_resource_locking = true

  tags = [
    {
      id       = "web"
      title    = "Web Server"
      aux_tags = []
    },
    {
      id       = "db"
      title    = "Database Server"
      aux_tags = []
    },
    {
      id       = "app"
      title    = "Application Server"
      aux_tags = []
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the tag group. This serves as the tag group ID.
- `tags` (Attributes List) List of tags within this tag group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `title` (String) Human-readable title for the tag group.

### Optional

- `help` (String) Help text describing the tag group. If not specified, defaults to empty string.
- `strict_resource_locking` (Boolean) Override provider-level strict_resource_locking for this resource. Controls ETag validation for resource operations. If not set, uses provider configuration.
- `topic` (String) Topic for grouping tag groups in the UI. If not specified, CheckMK defaults to 'Tags'.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the tag.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title for the tag.

Optional:

- `aux_tags` (List of String) List of auxiliary tag IDs associated with this tag. Optional, defaults to empty list.
